notas_originais: Sabb. 77 b אימת ח' וכ' the fear with which the weak inspires the strong person.—Ex. R. s. 24; Sifré Deut. 309; a. e.— Pl. חַלָּשִׁים, חַלָּשִׁין. Ex. R. l. c.
Targ. O. Deut. XXVIII, 44. Targ. I Sam. IX, 21.— Pl. חַלָּשִׁין, חֲלָ'. Targ. Ex. XXXII, 18.
Targ. I Kings XII, 10 Targ. Koh. X, 17; a. e.
Targ. Num. XV, 20.—Erub. 83 a אייתי ח' שדי עליהו he brought the priest’s portion in addition to it.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (חלל, cmp. חֵילַת I) um trabalho de vime solto usado para fazer colmeias, filtros, lagares de vinho, telas etc. Snh. 107 a תותי ח' atrás de uma tela (Rashi: colméia; Yalk. Sam. 148 כילתא).
definicoes_originais: (חלל, cmp. חֵילַת I) a loose wicker-work used for making bee-hives, strainers, for wine presses, screens &c. Snh. 107 a תותי ח' behind a screen (Rashi: bee-hive; Yalk. Sam. 148 כילתא).
notas_originais: Ib. פתקה לח' it (the arrow) made an opening in the screen. Sabb. 35 a ח' בת תרי כורי a basket containing two khor. Ib. 74 b האי מאן דעבד ח' he who makes a wicker-work on the Sabbath (going through the whole process of cutting reeds &c.).— Pl. חַלָּאתָא, חַלָּתָא. Ab. Zar. 75 a חלתא דיקולי וכ' Ms. M. (ed. דקולי וחלא', Ar. incorr. ח' דדיק') the palm or reed strainers which are twined with ropes of palm-rind.
, v. חִילְ'
, perf. of חֲמַם.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (n. h.) pr. n. m. Cam, filho de Noé.
definicoes_originais: (b. h.) pr. n. m. Ham, the son of Noah.
notas_originais: Snh. 69 b ח' גדול וכ' H. was the elder of Japheth by one year &c. Ib. 108 b ח' לקה בעורו H. was punished on his skin (was made black); Gen. R. s. 36 יצא ח' מפוהם Ḥ. came out (of the ark) blackened; a. e.

Pes. 75 b, sq.; a. fr.—Nidd. 43 a בשרו חם his membrum excited.— Pl. חַמִּים, חַמִּין (sub. מים) hot water. Sabb. 134 b ח' שהוחמו וכ' hot water which was made hot on the Sabbath; a. fr.—חַמֵּי טבריה the hot springs of Tiberias, in gen. natural hot water, opp. to חמי האור water heated by fire. Ḥull. 8 a (Neg. IX, 1 מֵי); a. fr.— Fem. חַמָּה. Makhsh. III, 3 פת ח' hot bread.

verbetes.glosa_atual: v. H. Ditado. 10 seg. v.) sogro, pai do marido, pai da esposa.
definicoes_originais: v. Ges. H. Dict. 10 s. v.) father-in-law, husband’s father, wife’s father.
notas_originais: Yeb. XV, 7 חָמִי my husband’s father. Ib. I, 1 חָמִיו his (the yabam’s) father-in-law. Pes. 87 a כלה בבית חָמִיהָ a bride in the house of her father-in-law (after being conducted to the husband’s home); a. v. fr.— Fem. חָמוֹת q. v.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Targ. Gen. XXXVIII, 13 חָמוּיִיךְ (ed. Berl. חֲ'; oth. חָמוּךְ). Targ. O.ib. 25 חֲמוּהָא. Targ. O. Ex. XVIII, 2 חֲמוּהִי ed. Berl. (outro. חָ', Y. חָמוֹי); um. e.-Y. Ber. Eu, bot 2d. Sim. B. Mets. 74 b בי חַמְוֵה na casa do oi
notas_originais: Targ. Gen. XXXVIII, 13 חָמוּיִיךְ (ed. Berl. חֲ'; oth. חָמוּךְ). Targ. O. ib. 25 חֲמוּהָא. Targ. O. Ex. XVIII, 2 חֲמוּהִי ed. Berl. (oth. חָ', Y. חָמוֹי); a. e.—Y. Ber. I, 2 d bot. חמוי. B. Mets. 74 b בי חַמְוֵה in the house of his daughter’s father-in-law. Kidd. 12 b; Yeb. 52 a חמוה his father-in-law. Ib. 117 b חֲמוּהָ her father-in-law; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Ḥ ama, nome de vários Amoraim.
definicoes_originais: Ḥ ama, name of several Amoraim.
notas_originais: Y. Nidd. III, 50 c bot. R. Ḥ., father of R. Hoshaya.—Y. Peah VIII, 21 b top; Y. Shek. V, 49 a bot.; a. e. (v. Fr. M’bo, p. 85 b).—Ib. 49 b; Y. Sabb. VI, 8 a; B. Mets. 86 b, a. fr. R. Ḥ. bar Ḥănina.—B. Kam. 99 b; Y. Kidd. III, 64 d, a. fr. R. Ḥ. bar Gurya.—Y. Erub. VII, 23 c; Bab. ib. 65 b bot. Ms. M. (ed. חנינא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) R. Ḥ. bar Joseph.—Y. Kil. VIII, 31 c top, a. fr. R. Ḥ. bar Ukba.
Dan. III, 13; 19.
Ab. Zar. 28 b bot. ח' לחמה Ms. M. a. Ar. (ed. חַמָּה) radishes are good for fever. Pes. 116 a קפא דחסא ח' וכ' against the injurious effects of lettuce apply radishes &c.

verbetes.glosa_atual: v. חמי) [prensado, grosso,] creme ou manteiga.
definicoes_originais: v. חמי) [ pressed, thick,] cream or butter.
notas_originais: Ber. 63 b (ref. to Prov. XXX, 33) ח' של תורה the cream of the Law (sound knowledge). B. Mets. 86 b בשכר ח' וכ' as a reward for the offer of cream and milk (Gen. XVIII, 8).
Targ. Prov. XXX, 33, v. חַאיְתָא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: [ser quente,] desejar, cobiçar; estar carnalmente excitado.; (= חָמַר) para produzir enrugamento pelo calor.; ser desejado, desejável.; ficar enrugado.
definicoes_originais: [ to be hot,] to desire, covet; to be carnally excited.
(= חָמַר) to produce shrivelling by heat.
(with ל) to be anxious for; to be pleased with.
notas_originais: Nidd. 20 b חֲמַדְתִּיו (or חִמַּ' Pi.) I had a desire for his embrace. Midr. Till. to Ps. XIX, 11 מי חְמָדָן which (of the two) holds them desirable; Yalk. ib. 676 [read]: מי החֹומְדִין. Mekh. Yithro, Baḥod. s. 8 שאתה חומד וכ' that you may desire his daughter for your son; ח' בדבור expressing a desire by words (without thinking of means to obtain the object of his desire). [Ib. ed. Weiss, אם התאוה סופו לַחֲמוֹד if one desires (what belongs to his neighbor), he will finally covet it (think of means to obtain it). Ib. אם ח' סופו וכ' if he covets, he will finally use force and rob. B. Mets. 5 b לאו דלא תַחְמוֹד, v. לַאו; a. fr.— Part. pass. חָמוּד, f. חֲמוּדָה desirable, precious. Pesik. R. s. 36 ח' ונאה precious and fine (of conduct).—Sabb. 88 b ח' גנוזה ed., v. חֶמְדָּה.—[
Snh. VII, 2 (52 a) Ar. (ref. to Dan. X, 3; Var. חמר).
Tanḥ. Vayera 5 שאתה נֶחְמָד לפני וכ' that thou art held desirable before the Lord; a. e.—[
Ḥull. III, 3 Ar., Var. נחמר, v. supra.]
Macc. III, 15 שנפשו … מתאוה להן ומְחַמַּדְתָּן which man longs for and covets.

Tanḥ. Mishp. 17 ארץ שנִתְחַמְּדוּ לה וכ' a land which all the great men were anxious to possess (Yalk. Jer. 271 שהָמְדוּ). Koh. R. to IX, 7 בוראך מִתְחַמֵּד לך thy Creator is pleased with thee; תורתו מִתְחַמֶּדֶת לך His law is &c.
Targ. Is. I, 29; a. fr.—Part. f. (חֲמֵידַת) חְמֵידָא. Targ. Y. Gen. IV, 1.
Targ. O. Gen. XXXI, 30 (Y. מִתְחַמְדָּא חֲמִדְתָּא).—Nidd. 66 a bot. מְחַמְּדָא, v. חִימּוּד.

same.—Targ. Y. Gen. l. c.—Ib. XXVIII, 10.—Y. Taan. III, 66 d top מִתְחֲמַד וכ' being desirous to hear her talk. Y. Sabb. VI, 8 c bot. הוו מִתְחַמְּדִין וכ' were anxious to see &c. Koh. R. to IX, 10; a. e.
Sabb. 152 a חַמְדֵּיה.

verbetes.glosa_atual: precedeu. wds.) 1) mesmo.; mesmo. Sab. 152 a (expl. אביונה, Koh. XII, 5) זו ח' isso significa o apetite sexual; (Koh. R. para l. c. תַּאֲוָה).; desejabilidade, objeto desejável, presente precioso.
definicoes_originais: same. Sabb. 152 a (expl. אביונה, Koh. XII, 5) זו ח' that means the sexual appetite; (Koh. R. to l. c. תַּאֲוָה).
notas_originais: f. (b. h.; preced. wds.)

Tanḥ. Sh’moth 29, a. e. דבר שהוא ח' מתוך ח' something which is the most desirable of all desirable things. Y. Taan. II, beg. 65 a כלי אחד של ח' the only precious vessel (the Torah) left to us. Sabb. 88 b ח' גנוזה Ms. M. (ed. חמודה) a reserved treasure (the Law); a. fr.
, v. הַמְדָּן
ch. = h. חֶמְדָּה. Targ. Zech. VII, 14; Targ. Jer. III, 19. V. חֲמִידְתָּא

verbetes.glosa_atual: calor, raiva.; Ḥ emah, nome alegórico de um dos anjos da justiça.
definicoes_originais: Ḥ emah, allegorical name of one of the angels of justice.
notas_originais: Snh. 82 b משיב ח' בן וכ' he is an allayer of (divine) anger, the son of &c. Num. R. s. 20 נתמלא עליה ח' he became angry at her. Lam. R. to I, 6 חֲמָתוֹ של הב"ה the anger of the Lord; a. fr.
Ex. R. s. 41, end; a. e., v. אַף II.

Ber. 59 b ח' בתקופתה the sun starting on his new cycle (of twenty eight years). Num. R. s. 14 י"ב הדשים לח' the twelve solar months. Ned. III, 7 רואי הח' those seeing (or feeling) the sun; שלא נתכוין … שהח' וכ' for he meant him whom the sun sees; a. v. fr.—Yeb. VIII, 4, a. fr. סריס ח' a eunuch from the time of seeing the sun, i.e. born without visible testicles; opp. to סריס אדם.

Sabb. 137 a, a. e., v. חָלַץ. Y. Sabb. XIX, end, 17 b, v. אָחַז. Gen. R. s. 19, a. e., v. אַבְאָבִית. Y. Sabb. I, end, 4 b (prov.) פת חמה חַמָּתָהּ בצדה hot bread has its heat by its side, i.e. eating hot bread causes fever; a. fr.
Ab. Zar. 28 b bot., v. חַמָּא.—V. חַמַּת.

verbetes.glosa_atual: cap. = h. חֶמְדָּה. Targ. Jud. V, 30 (ed. Lag. חֲמוּדָה).
notas_originais: ch. = h. חֶמְדָּה. Targ. Jud. V, 30 (ed. Lag. חֲמוּדָה).
— Pl. חֲמוֹדִין, חֲמוֹדַיָּא. Targ. Y. Ex. XX, 14; Deut. V, 18 (ed. Amst. חֲמוּ').
, v. חָמַד, חֶמְדָּה a. חֲמוּדָא.
&c., v. חָמָא I

, v. חֲמִילָה

— Pl. חַמּוּמוֹת. Y. Snh. VI, 23 b bot. היו ידיו ח' his hands were heated, i.e. he was very severe in executing judgment.
, v. חִימּ'
— Pl. חַמּוּקִים. Yalk. Ex. 370 שתי ידות … ח' two handles (pins) of the shape of two rundles, v. חָרַץ.

verbetes.glosa_atual: c. (b. h.; v. חָמַר II a. חֲמִיר I); [portador de carga, cmp. גָּמָל.; (cmp. vários usos do cavalo) um dispositivo para trabalhadores, descanso, macaco, ações etc. Kel. XIV, 3 ח' של נפחין o burro do ferreiro ('no qual o ferreiro se senta enquanto usa sua cabeça como bigorna', Maim.; 'o resto do fole', R. S.).
definicoes_originais: c. (b. h.; v. חָמַר II a. חֲמִיר I)

(cmp. various uses of horse) a contrivance for working-men, rest, jack, stocks &c. Kel. XIV, 3 ח' של נפחין the smiths’ ass (‘on which the smith sits while using its head as an anvil’, Maim.; ‘the rest of the bellows’, R. S.).
notas_originais: ] ass. Nidd. 31 a, v. גָּרַם. Sabb. 152 a דעל ח' וכ' he who rides an ass is a freeman. B. Bath. 143 a את וח' thou and the ass (shall own my property, a form of donation implying a rational and an irrational being).—Bekh. I, 2 ח' שילדה וכ' if an ass gave birth to &c. Snh. 33 a הלכה חֲמוֹרְךָ וכ' thy ass is gone, Tarfon! (I shall have to make compensation for erroneous judgment); a. fr.

Ib. XVIII, 3 וח' a stand on which the bedstead is placed. Gen. R. s. 65, end ח' של חרשים carpenters’ sawing-jack (an instrument for torture); Ib. s. 70 (alluding to Prov. XXVII, 22) אפי' … בח' של חרשים וכ' even if you put the wicked man on a carpenter’s jack, you cannot make anything useful out of him (sufferings will have no effect on him); Yalk. Kings 201; Yalk. Prov. 961; (Pesik. Shek., p. 15 a במכתש).— Pl. חֲמוֹרִים. Sabb. 112 b. Gen. R. s. 75; a. fr.—Denom. חַמָּר, חִמִּר.— Fem. חֲמוֹרָה. Tosef. Kil. V, 5.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (חָמַר I) pesado, pesado, importante; estrito, severo, rigoroso, restritivo.
definicoes_originais: (חָמַר I) heavy, weighty, important; strict, severe, stringent, restrictive.
notas_originais: Kel. I, 4 ח' שבכולם וכ' the most stringent of all are the laws concerning corpses.—איסור ח', v. אִיסּוּר.—Snh. 50 a שריפה ח' וכ' death by burning is a severer punishment than &c. Ib. IX, 4, a. e. נידון בח' he suffers the severer penalty of the two. Ab. II, 1 כבחמורה as in the observance of a difficult commandment (requiring self-denial); a. fr.— Pl. חֲמוּרִים, חֲמוּרִין, f. חֲמוּרוֹת. Hull. XII, 5; a. fr.—Y. Snh. X, 28 b top חֲמוּרוֹתָיו של וכ' (not חומר') the heaviest sins that Jeroboam committed.—דורשי חֲמוּרוֹת, v. חוֹמֶר II. קלים וחֲמוּרִים, v. חוֹמֶר I.
, v. חֲמוֹר
Gen. R. s. 75, v. גְּמַלְתָּא.

Yeb. I, 1 חֲמוֹתוֹ the yabam’s wife’s mother. Ib. XVI, 1 היתה לה ח' וכ' if the childless widow had a mother-in-law abroad (who may have given birth to a son), she need not take it into consideration (and may marry again); a. fr.
Targ. Deut. XXVII, 23; a. e.; v. חֲמָתָא

verbetes.glosa_atual: (cmp.חמץ); estar escuro.; ser amargo, salgado, v. חוּמְטוֹן.; ficar inflamado, ficar incomodado.
definicoes_originais: to be bitter, salty, v. חוּמְטוֹן.
notas_originais: —Denom. חוּמְטָא.
Sabb. 54 b Ar., v. next w.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (cmp. חבט) derrubar.; prostrar, subjugar.; bater, ser espancado.
notas_originais: — Part. pass. חָמֵיט, חֲמִיט prostrated, kneeling, (as verb) to kneel. Targ. Is. XLVI, 1. Targ. Ps. XCV, 6 נַחֲמוֹט (some ed. נַחֲמִיט). Targ. Y. Deut. XXVIII, 35 חֲמִיטְתּוּן … עבירתא (some ed. חַמִּי' incorr.; not עבידתא); cmp. Targ. Job IV, 4 דחָמְטָן. [Koh. R. to IV, 9, end חמטת, some ed., read: דמָטַת.]
Targ. Ps. XVII, 13. Ib. XVIII, 40 Reg. (ed. תברתא).
same. Ib. LXXVIII, 31.
Sabb. 54 b דלא לִיחַמְטָן אליתייהו Ms. M. (ed. incorr.) that their tails may not knock against (the rocks &c., Rashi; Ar.: ‘may not ulcerate’; v. Syr. חמטא pustula, ulcus, P. Sm. 1303; v. preced.).
, v. חֲמִיטָה

verbetes.glosa_atual: (árabe. ḥ ama tueri) [cercar, guardar, v. חוֹמָה,] observar, ver (no dialeto Y.).; (seguido por (seguido por מ־, cmp. סור) virar (o olho) de.; fazer ver, mostrar.; ser visto, aparecer.
definicoes_originais: (Arab. ḥ ama tueri) [ to surround, guard, v. חוֹמָה,] to observe, see (in Y. dialect).
(followed by (followed by מ־, cmp. סור) to turn ( the eye) from.
to cause to see, to show.
notas_originais: Targ. Y. Gen. I, 4 (O. חזא); a. v. fr.—Targ. Prov. XXIII, 33 Ms. (ed. ויחַוְור').—Y. Peah III, 17 d bot. אתא חמי (= תא חזי, h. בא וראה) come and see. Gen. R. s. 14 דאת חָמֵי לאפויי וכ' (not דאתח') that thou shalt see his face in the hereafter; Midr. Till. to Ps. II; Yalk. ib. 621 חמוי (corr. acc.). Ib. חַמְתֵיה (fr. חמה) he saw him. Pesik. Eth Korb. p. 57 b (v. Bub. note 15) חַמְתִי אכיל חַמְתִי שתי did he (Moses) see me (the Lord) eat &c.?; Yalk. Num. 776 חַמְתֵיה וכ' did he see Him &c.?; a. fr.— Part. pass. חֲמֵי (v. חֲזִי) fit, worthy. Targ. Ps. XV, 1. Ib. LVIII, 2 (ed. חֲמִי); a. fr.—Fem. חַמְיָא. Targ. Y. Ex. XXII, 16.
Targ. Prov. XXVIII, 27 (Ar. מהמי, h. text מעלים, v. Syr. המא P. Sm. 1017).
Targ. Y. Gen. XLI, 28; a. e.—Lam. R. to I, 1 ואַחְמִין ליה וכ' and showed him a measure full of denars. Ib. רבתי (חד כות' 1) דכל עמא מַחְמִין לי וכ' that all people point at me with their fingers.
same. Y. Kil. IX, 32 b bot.; Y. Keth. XII, 35 a bot. חַמֵּי (לה) לי let me see it (the tooth).

Targ. Y. Gen. VIII, 5; a. fr.—[Targ. Ps. XLII, 3 אִתַּחֲמֵי Ms. ( Ittaf.) I shall appear before (h. text אֵרָאֶה, Var. a. ed. אֶחְמֵי)].—M. Kat. 25 b אִתְחֲמִיאוּ וכ' stars were seen in day time. Y. Peah VIII, end, 21 b דחמי ולא מִתְחֲמֵי He who sees but cannot be seen. Lam. R. introd. (R. Joḥ.
מִתְחַמְאִין, v. מַשְׁתָּיֵי; a. e.
, v. חֲמַד

verbetes.glosa_atual: f. cap. = h. חֶמְדָּה. Targ. Sou. V, 11 (ed. Wil. חֶמְדָתָא, ed. Lag. חֶמְדָּאתָא). Targ. É. XXXII, 12.-Ib. XXVI, 8 חֲמִידַת constr.
notas_originais: f. ch. = h. חֶמְדָּה. Targ. Am. V, 11 (ed. Wil. חֶמְדָתָא, ed. Lag. חֶמְדָּאתָא). Targ. Is. XXXII, 12.—Ib. XXVI, 8 חֲמִידַת constr.
, v. אַמִּיתָא

verbetes.glosa_atual: (חמט II, cmp. חוּבְטָא, חָבִיץ) uma massa com a qual são feitos bolos achatados, bolo de massa.
definicoes_originais: (חמט II, cmp. חוּבְטָא, חָבִיץ) a batter of which flat cakes are made, batter-cake.
notas_originais: T’bul Yom I, 1. Ib. II, 4; Tosef. ib. II, 2 (ed. Zuck. חמיתה, corr. acc.). Maasr. I, 7 נותן לחמי' ed. Y. a. Ms. M. (Bab. ed. a. Mish. לחֲמָטָה) he may put (the oil) on the cake (Maim.: into the pan); Tosef. ib. I, 7; 9 נותן להם מיטה ed. Zuck. (Var. לחמיתה, carr. acc.)— Pl. חֲמִיטֹות. Y. Ter. X, 47 a bot. חמטתינו (read: חֲמִיטוֹתֵינוּ or חֲמָ').
, v. הֵמְטַלְיָא

חמל, P. Sm. 1303, sq.) a blanket of thick, coarse stuff. Ned. VII, 3. Ib. 55 b; Tosef. Sabb. V (VI), 14 מילא ed. Zuck. (Var. המלא, חמלא).— Pl. חֲמִילֹות. Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. V, 11. Tosef. Neg. V, 14 חמולות (corr. acc.).

verbetes.glosa_atual: c. = h. חָם II, quente, quente, fresco.
definicoes_originais: c. = h. חָם II, warm, hot, fresh.
notas_originais: Targ. I Sam. XXI, 7; a. e.—Y. Shebi. IV, 35 a bot., a. e. פיתא ח' fresh bread. Erub. 3 a; B. Bath. 24 b (prov.) קדרא … לא ח' וכ' a pot belonging to two partners is neither warm nor cold. Ḥull. 6 b בר … ליכול ח' let the scholar eat fresh food, and I shall be contented with cold; a. fr.— Pl. חַמִּימִין, חַמִּימֵי hot water (v. חָם II). Y. Ab. Zar. IV, 44 b bot. חמר וח' wine mixed with hot water. Ḥull. 46 b.—Sabb. 55 a רישך בקרירי … בח' thy chief (I) shall be punished with cold water, but thy chief’s chief (the Resh Galutha) with boiling water (he is reponsible); a. e.
Pes. 76 a מחמת ח' דחרס through the heat of the earthen vessel.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (cmp. Árabe. ḥ amâm) [de cor escura] uma espécie de pombas, pombas aneladas (?).
definicoes_originais: (cmp. Arab. ḥ amâm) [ dark-colored] a species of doves, ring-doves (?).
notas_originais: Gitt. 69 b (oth. opin. hens).
m. = חַמִּים. Y. Ber. IV, 7 b top שמשא ח' it is warm in the sun, טולא ח' in the shade. [Midr. Till. to Ps. XXIV ימא דח', v. חֲמָץ.] [ח', pl. of חָם II.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: aqueles que usam palavras como ḥ amis (ἥμισυ, cmp. חומס), uma zombaria dos estudiosos talmúdicos que usam palavras estrangeiras.
definicoes_originais: those using such words as ḥ amis (ἥμισυ, cmp. חומס), a mockery on Talmudic scholars using foreign words.
notas_originais: Snh. 14 a כל מן דין … לא מסרמיסין ולא מסרמיטין מח' וכ' Ms. F. a. Ag. Hatt. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 7; ed. ואמרי לה לא מח') such men (as R. Ammi &c.) appoint for us, but do not appoint for us any of those using such words like sermis (semis, ἥμισυ) sermit (prob. distortion of tremis), hemis or tremis (cmp. Y. Gitt. IV, 47 b quot. s. v. גּוֹרְדְּיָינִי). [Oth. opin. v. Rashi, a. Ar. s. v.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: (= חמיש עסר) quinze; o décimo quinto.
notas_originais: Targ. Y. Lev. XXIII, 6. Ib. XII, 4; a. e.—Meg. 5 b בר ח' one observing Purim on the fifteenth of Ădar; a. e.
Targ. I Chr. XXIV, 14.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (חמע); azedo.; (Targ. Y. חָמִיעַ) = h. חָמֵץ, levedado (pão).
definicoes_originais: (Targ. Y. חָמִיעַ) = h. חָמֵץ, leavened ( bread).
notas_originais: Lam. R. to III, 40, v. בְּסִימָא.
Targ. Ex. XII., 15; a. fr.—Y. Snh. III, 21 b הורו מיפי ח' וכ' they permitted to bake leavened bread on Passover (for the troops).
, v. חֲמַץ
, v. חָמֵץ

verbetes.glosa_atual: = h. חָמוּר; carregado.; grave, estrito, rigoroso.
notas_originais: Targ. Y. Gen. XLIX, 14 ח' באורייתא loaded with the (knowledge of the) Law.

Targ. Y. Num. XIV, 30.—Ḥull. 10 a ח' סכנתא וכ' regulations concerning health and life are made more stringent than ritual laws; a. fr.— Pl. f. חֲמִירָתָא restrictions, strict measures. Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41 d bot. מן ח' דרב one of Rab’s strict regulations.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (חֲמַר II) fermento forte (h. שְׂאֹר); pão fermentado.
definicoes_originais: (חֲמַר II) strong leaven (h. שְׂאֹר); leavened bread.
notas_originais: Targ. Ex. XII, 15; a. fr.—Pes. 5 b, v. בְּעַר.—Ab. Zar. 66 a ח' דשערי leaven of barley flour. Men. 43 a, v. אַרְכְּסָא; a. fr.
, v. חֲמֵשׁ
, v. חֲמִישַׁי

verbetes.glosa_atual: quinto; (sub. יום) o quinto dia da semana.
definicoes_originais: fifth; (sub. יום) the fifth day of the week.
notas_originais: Meg. I, 2, sq.; a. fr.— Fem. חֲמִישִׁית. Ib. III, 4 בח' on the fifth Sabbath; a. fr.—Esp. (Lev. V, 24) the penalty of the fifth part added to the indemnity. B. Kam. 65 b.— Pl. חֲמִישִׁיּוֹת. Ib. (ref. to חֲמִשִׁתָיו, Lev. l. c.) ח' הרבה וכ' (ed. חֲמִשִׁ') repeated penalties connected with one object of indemnity.

Targ. Gen. I, 23 (ed. Amst. שָׁאִי …); a. fr.— Fem. חֲמִישֵׁיתָא, שִׁיתָא … Targ. Lev. XIX, 25.—Pesik. R. s. 23 (ed. Fr. p. 115 b) חֲמִישְׁתָּא; ib. (p. 120 a) חמשיתא (corr. acc.) the fifth day of the week.—V. חֲמְשִׁיתָא.
, v. אַמִּיתָא
, v. חֲמִיטָה

definicoes_originais: (b. h.) [ to be warm,] to have compassion.
notas_originais: Men. 53 b (play on המולה, Jer. XI, 16) חָמַלְתִּי עליהם I had mercy on them.
, v. חֲמִילָה
, v. הִימַלְתָּא

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. próximo w.; cmp. ἄμωμον, v. Sm. Ant. s. v.) amomum, uma especiaria indiana (também siríaca).
definicoes_originais: (v. next w.; cmp. ἄμωμον, v. Sm. Ant. s. v.) amomum, an Indian (also Syriac) spice.
notas_originais: Ukts. III, 5 (some ed. incorr. חמס); Nidd. 51 b חימות (corr. acc.); Sifré Deut. 107 חימום; Y. Erub. IX, end, 25 d חכם (corr. acc.); Y. Ḥag. III, 79 c חמה (corr. acc.).—Gen. R. s. 45, beg. הִ' היא צריכה (הימוס, corr. acc.) she needs amomum (as medicine for sterility). Cmp. הִימַלְתָּא, אַמִּיתָא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (b. h.) estar morno, quente; [(de cor) ser escuro, vermelho; (de sabor) ser picante, azedo, amargo].; aquecer, aquecer, ferver.; para ser aquecido.; aquecer-se; para ficar aquecido.
definicoes_originais: (b. h.) to be warm, hot; [(of color) to be dark, red; (of taste) to be pungent, sour, bitter].
to warm one’s self; to become heated.
notas_originais: Part. חָם, q. v.

Y. Ned. IV, 38 c bot. לחַמֵּם בו את ידיו to warm his hands against it (the bread). Gen. R. s. 14, end מְחַמֶּמֶת הגוף keeps the body warm. Sabb. 40 b ומְחַמַּמְתָּהּ וכ' and warms it (her hand) before the fire; a. fr.

same. Bets. II, 5 לא יֵחֵם וכ' one must not prepare warm water for &c. Sabb. 40 a התחילו … להָחֵם בשבת the bathers began to heat (the water) on the Sabbath; a. fr.—Part. מֵיחֵם, מֵחֵם, pl. מְחַמִּין. Ib. b; Tosef. ib. III (IV), 7 מיחם אדם וכ' (ed. Zuck. מייחם, read: מֵיחֵים), v. אְלוּנְטִית I; [Y. ib. XIX, 17 a bot. מחמין הוא אדם (read as ib. IX, 12 a bot. מְחַמֵּם הוא וכ'].—Ib. אם מפני הסכנה מְחַמִּין לו וכ' if it is for the sake of averting danger to life, may we not even boil water on the Sabbath?—Bets. 22 a; a. v. fr.
Sabb. III, 5 (41 a) בשביל שיֵחַמּוּ that they become warm; ib. 41 b שיֵחוֹמּוּ; Tosef. ib. III (IV), 5 שׁיֵיחַמּוּ; a. e.
same. Sabb. 134 b שהוּחַמּוּ, v. חָם II. Y. Bets. II, 61 c; a. fr.—B. Mets. VI, 3 הוּחַמָּה the animal was overtaken by the heat.

Bets. II, 5; Tosef. Sabb. l. c. Tam. I, 1. Ab. II, 10 הוי מִתְחַמֵּם וכ' warm thyself by the fire of the scholars (try to associate with them); a. fr.—Y. Sot. I, 16 c bot. נתח' was heated (had pollution). Gen. R. s. 24 מִתְחַמְּמִים, מִתְחַמְּמוֹת conceived

verbetes.glosa_atual: aquecer, aquecer.; aquecer, excitar, v. para se aquecer.; para conter a raiva.
notas_originais: Targ. O. Gen. XVIII, 1; a. e.; v. חוּם
— Part. pass. מְחַמַּם. Targ. Hos. VII, 7.
—2) אַחְמַם to become hot; to have pollution. Nidd. 43 a כל אחְמוּמֵי והדר א' וכ' getting heated once and again immediately after.
Targ. Y. II Gen. XVIII, 1.—Sabb. 110 b כד איח' ed. (Ms. M. אַחְ', v. supra) when he had warmed himself.—*
Targ. II Esth. V, 10 [prob. to be read: ואִתְחַמַּס, v. חֲמַס; cmp. חֲסַן].

verbetes.glosa_atual: v. חַמָּה) colunas solares, [prob.; אלו הח' וכ' isso significa os ḥ amanim nos telhados. Mekh. Bo, s. 11 (ref. ao Ex. XII, 2 משכי מחַמָּנֵיכֶם retire-se de seu ḥ.
definicoes_originais: אלו הח' וכ' that means the ḥ ammanim on roof-tops. Mekh. Bo, s. 11 (ref. to Ex. XII, 2 משכי מחַמָּנֵיכֶם withdraw from your ḥ.
notas_originais: a phallus, cmp. חֲנִיסְנְסַיָּא]. Sifra B’har ch. IX, end (ref. to לא תקימו, Lev. XXVI,
Ib. Yithro, s. 5, end לח'. Ib. s. 6 מן הח' (ed. Weiss a. Fr. everywhere ע"ז).
, Ukts. III, 5, v. חֲמָם

verbetes.glosa_atual: v. H. Ditado. 10 seg. v.) [ser acalorado, apaixonado,] insultar, praticar violência, roubar.; estar arruinado (cmp. חָבַל).; (de bestas predadoras) para agarrar com presas, arranhar com unhas.
definicoes_originais: v. Ges. H. Dict. 10 s. v.) [ to be heated, passionate,] to insult, do violence, to rob.
(of beasts of prey) to seize with fangs, scratch with nails.
notas_originais: Y. Ab. Zar. II, 40 d bot. לא סוף … אלא חֲמוֹס וכ' finally one does not say to another man, Kill that man, but, Attack &c. Gen. R. s. 45 (ref. to חמסי, ib. XVI, 5) חוֹמְסֵנִי את בדברים וכ' thou provokest me to speak harshly, because thou seest &c. Ib. s. 65, beg. מלכות … גוזלת וחוֹמֶסֶת the wicked government (Rome) robs and extorts; a. fr.—Lev. R. s. 26 דור ודור וחוֹמְסָיו each generation with its violent men.—Part. pass. חָמוּס. Ib. s. 30 גזול אני ח' אני I have been taken by force, by extortion.
Lam. R. to II, 6 כגנה שנ' מעיינה וכ' like a garden the spring of which has been ruined, so that its vegetables fade.

Gen. R. s. 45 (play on חמסי, v. supra) חִימְּסָה פניו Ar. (ed. בפניו, some ed. חימסא, incorr.) she scratched his face; Y’lamd. to Gen. l. c. (quot. in Ar.) חיטטה אותו וחימסה פניו כנמיה she scratched him and marked his face like a marten; Yalk. ib. 79 (not חומסה).

verbetes.glosa_atual: fazer violência contra si mesmo, restringir-se.
definicoes_originais: to do violence to one’s self, to restrain one’s self.
notas_originais: —Denom. חומָסָא.
Targ. II Esth. V, 10, v. חֲמַם. [Targ. Y. Gen. VII, 21 אתחמסי, read: אִתְמְסִי or אִתְהַמְסִי, v. מְסִי.]

Y. B. Mets. IV, 9 c bot. (ref. to Gen. VI, 13) מה היה חֲמָסָן what was the nature of their violence? Gen. R. s. 31 (distinction between ח' a. גֶּזֶל); a. e.— Pl. חֲמָסִים. Ib. s. 65 … שלא גזילות ח' that thou wilt not give me to eat what has been obtained by robbery or extortion. Lev. R. s. 2. Koh. R. to III, 9; a. e.

B. Kam. 62 a (defining the difference between the ח' and the גַּזְלָן) ח' יהיב וכ' the ḥ amsan takes by force and pays.— Pl. חַמְסָנִים, חַמְסָנִין. Snh. 25 b הוסיפו עליהן … והח' (Ar. והחוֹ') they added to them (the class of persons disqualified for judges or witnesses) the robbers and those taking forcibly (and paying); Y. Shebu. VII, 37 d bot.; Y. R. Hash. I, 57 c top.
חִמֵּעַ. Ab. Zar. 68 a לחַמֵּעַ, Ms. M. לחַמֵּץ.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ser azedo; para ser levedado.; para fermentar.; azedar, fermentar, fermentar.; para causar fermentação.
definicoes_originais: to be sour; to be leavened.
notas_originais: Targ. O. Ex. XII, 34; a. e.; v. חֲמִיעַ.—Y. Pes. II, end, 29 c בגין דיִחְמַע that it might turn sour (vinegar).
Pes. 41 a חַמּוּעֵי מְחַמֵּעַ (not מחמעא; Rashi: אַחְמוּעֵי מַחְמַע Af.) (the flour) causes leavening.— Part. pass. מְחַמַּע, v. infra.
. Targ. Y. Ex. l. c.
Targ. Y. II Lev. II, 11 דמַחְמַע (Var. דמְחַמַּע); v. supra.

definicoes_originais: [ to be hot,] to do violence, to wrong.
notas_originais: Snh. 35 a (ref. to Is. I, 17) אשרו חָמוּץ ולא חוֹמֵץ right the oppressed, but not the oppressor (listen to the complainant first); Yoma 39 b

verbetes.glosa_atual: v. precedido.) [ estar quente,] fermentar, ser azedo.; causar fermentação.; mesmo. Pes. 40 iguais.; azedar, fermentar.
definicoes_originais: v. preced.) [ to be hot,] to ferment, be sour.
notas_originais: Ad. Zar. 68 b מי גרם לה שתֶּחְמַץ וכ' what was the cause that it (the dough) became leavened (rose) in one hour?

Ib. a ראויה לחַמֵּץ וכ' Ms. M. (ed. לחַמֵּעַ) fit to leaven with it many other doughs. Ib. וחִימְּצוּ; Orl. II, 11 נצטרפו וחִמְּצוּ (Y. ed. הצטרפו וחִימֵּיצוּ) and the two combined produced the required leavening, Ib. 9 וחִמְּצָהּ (Y. ed. וחִימֵּיצָהּ; Ab. Zar. l. c. והֶחְמִיצָהּ) and it made the dough rise. Orl. II 6 כל המְחַמֵּץ whatever is used for producing fermentation; a. fr.—Trnsf. to mature, to continue a case over night, to reserve judgment. Snh. 35 a (ref. to Is I, 17, v. preced.) אשרו דיין שמְחַמֵּץ את וכ' Ms. K. (ed. אשרי, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 20) praise the judge (in capital cases) who reserves his judgment (over night); Yalk. Is. 257.

Pes. 40 a מי פירות אינן מַחְמִיצִין juice of fruits produces no leavening (in the ritual sense). Ab. Zar. 68 a כדי להחמיץ (Orl. II, 8 לחַמֵּץ) enough to leaven the dough. Mekh. Bo s. 10 שאור שהוא מַחְמִיץ לאחרים leaven which is used for leavening other doughs; a. fr.—Trnsf. to procrastinate. Ib. s. 9 (play on המַצּוֹת, Ex. XII, 17) כדרך … אין מַחְמִיצִין את המִצְוָה as well as you must not allow the matsah to become sour, so you must not allow the mitsvah (religious act) to become sour by postponement; Yalk. Ex. 201.

Ab. Zar. 68 b ראויה להַחְמִיץ וכ' (Ms. M. לחמע) is likely to ferment in two hours. Nidd. IX, 7 מי רגלים שהֶחְמִיצוּ urin which ferments.—Trnsf. to degenerate, become wicked. R. Hash. 3 b קודם שה' before he (the Persian King) changed for the worse.
Pes. 28 b; 43 a נ' מאליו became sour of itself (not through a leavening means).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (precedido. wds.); ser quente, (de cor) vermelho, v. חִימּוּצָא, חִימּוּצָתָא.; ser azedo, salgado etc.; para envergonhar.
definicoes_originais: to be hot, (of color) red, v. חִימּוּצָא, חִימּוּצָתָא.
notas_originais: Targ. Prov. X, 1 (h. text תוגת), v. חִימּוּצָא.
Ib. XXV, 8; XXVIII, 7 (Ms. Pa.; h. text הכלים).
R. Hash. 4 a מנלן דא' what evidence have we that he became wicked?, v. preced.

verbetes.glosa_atual: precedeu. wds.) pão fermentado, qualquer coisa que contenha substância fermentada (das cinco espécies de grãos, v. Ḥall.
definicoes_originais: preced. wds.) leavened bread, anything containing leavened substance (of the five species of grain, v. Ḥall.
notas_originais: I, 1, sq.). Pes. I, 1, v. בָּדַק. Ib. II, 2 ח' של עכ"ום וכ' ḥ amets belonging to a gentile over which the Passover passed (which existed during the Passover week). Ib. 3 על חֲמֵצוֹ (trad. pronunc. חֶמְצוֹ as if fr. חֵמֶץ) on ḥ. belonging to him. Y. Shebi. VIII, 38 b bot. חֲמֵיצָן של וכ' ḥ. belonging to Samaritans; Y. Ab. Zar. V, 44 d bot. אכל חמצין (read: חֲמֵיצָן) ate their (the Samaritans’) ḥ. (immediately after Passover); a. v. fr.— Pl. חֲמֵצִים, חֲמֵצין salads, v. חוּמְצָן.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (Gr. Ἔμεσα, Ἔμισσα) Ḥămâts, Emesa (mod. Hums) uma cidade da Síria na margem oriental do Orontes. General R. s. 37; Y. Meg. Eu, 71b bot. (expl. צמרי, Gen. X, 18).
definicoes_originais: (Gr. Ἔμεσα, Ἔμισσα) Ḥămâts, Emesa (mod. Hums) a city of Syria on the Eastern bank of the Orontes. Gen. R. s. 37; Y. Meg. I, 71 b bot. (expl. צמרי, Gen. X, 18).
notas_originais: —Y. Kil. IX, 32 c bot.; Y. Keth. XII, 35 b bot. ימא דח' the Lake of E. (an artificial bay made under Diocletian); Midr. Till. to Ps. XXIV ימא דחמין (corr. acc.).—Denom. חֲמָצָאֵי, חוֹמְצָאֵי m. pl. inhabitants of Emesa. Targ. Y. Gen. X, 18; Targ. I Chr. I, 16.
, v. חִימְ'.—[חמצין, Y. Ab. Zar. V, 44 d bot., v. חָמץ II.]
Yoma 39 a, sq. (Ms. O. omits בן); Kidd. 53 a; v. חָאפוּן.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (cmp.חָבַר); aderir; empilhar, carregar.; (denominação de חָמוּר) ser pesado, rigoroso.; [colocar peso,] aprovar uma lei restritiva, inclinar-se a uma opinião mais estrita, opp. היקל para facilitar.
definicoes_originais: to join; to pile up, to load.
(denom. of חָמוּר) to be weighty, stringent.
[ to put a load on,] to pass a restrictive law, to incline to the stricter opinion, opp. היקל to make easy.
notas_originais: Ukts. II, 5 והבצלים שחֲמָרָן and the onions which one has piled up; v. אָמַן.—Zeb. 53 a וחוֹמֵר בגודלו וכ' and loads (i.e. supports the index finger) with his thumb on top and the little finger below (like a balanced load, v. חֶבֶר a. אֵבֶר); [Var. סוֹמֵךְ, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 3]; Yalk. Lev. 469.
Ohol. XIV, 3 אל יֶחְמוֹר זה וכ' this must not be made more stringent than &c.; [ed. Dehr. יַחְמִיר.]

Yeb. 88 a מתיך חומר שהֶחְמַרְתָּ עליה וכ' on account of the restrictions under which the law puts her in the end (if she marries again and her first husband appears), it is made easy for her in the beginning (by allowing her to marry again), i.e. her heavy responsibility will make her cautious; Y. verbetes.glosa_atual: como precedente. Hif.—Y.; ser empilhado, formar uma pilha de ruínas (cmp. גַּל).
definicoes_originais: to be piled up, to form a pile of ruins (cmp. גַּל).
notas_originais: Shek. VII, 50 c bot. [read:] חמתון מקילין לון וחַ' וכ' he saw them to be lax in their practices, and he enjoined strictness on them. Yeb. 88 a לא לִיחַמֵּיר וכ' let one not put her under heavy restrictions (in the end), and not make it too easy for her (in the beginning, v. preced.). Nidd. 66 a היכא דאַחְמוּר וכ' in those cases in which they have placed themselves under greater restrictions (than the law requires, v. preced.), they have done so (and follow the usage like a law), but where they have not &c. (you cannot extend the adopted usage by analogy); a. fr.— Part. pass. מַחְמַר, מְחַמַּר piled up, ruins; v. מַחְמר a. דִּמְחַמְרָא.
Targ. Is. XVII, 9; XXX, 13.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (b. h.) [ser quente,]; brilhar, ressecar (cmp. כָּמַר).; estar ressecado.
notas_originais: Snh. VII, 2 וחוֹמֶרֶת את וכ' and parches his entrails; (Ar., v. חָמַד).

Ḥull. III, 3 נפלה לאור ונֶחְמְרוּ וכ' if the bird fell into fire, and (on examination after slaughtering it was found that) its bowels were affected by inhaling heat (Ar., v. חָמַד). Gen. R. s. 38, end.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ,; estar quente, ressecado.; fermentar, v. próximo w., a. חֲמִירָא.
definicoes_originais: to ferment, v. next w., a. חֲמִירָא.
notas_originais: Targ. Job XXX, 27 חֲמַרוּ (Var. חֲמָרוּ, Ms. חַמָּרוּ Pa.; h. text רתח').

Targ. Num. VI, 3; a. fr.—Targ. Hos. III, 1 בחַמְרֵיה ed. Lag. (ed. בחבריה, corr. acc.) in his wine (intoxication).—Sabb. 77 a, a. e., v. דְּרֵי II. Ḥull. 112 a קרי ליה חמר בשר (Ar. המר) called it (that juice) meat-wine.—Gen. R. s. 91 end ח' קטף wine mixed with resin.—Erub. 53 b, v. אִימַּר; a. fr.— Pl. חַמְרִין. Targ. Y. Gen. L, 1.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ,; bunda; trnsf. invenção do trabalhador, jack etc. Targ. É. XXI, 7.; ח' דמיא burro marinho, nome de um peixe marinho, pescada (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Onos).
definicoes_originais: ass; trnsf. workingman’s contrivance, jack &c. Targ. Is. XXI, 7.
ח' דמיא sea-ass, name of a sea fish, hake (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Onos).
notas_originais: Targ. Ex. XIII, 13; a. fr.—Sabb. 66 b; Y. ib. VI, 8 c, v. אָנְקִטְמִין; a. v. fr.— Pl. חֲמָרִין, חֲמָרַיָּא, חֲמָרֵי. Targ. Gen. XII, 16 (Y. ed. Amst. חַמְרִין). Ib. XXXVI, 24 (Y. ed. Amst. חַמְרַיָּא); a. e.—Gen. R. s. 38 (ref. to בני האדם, Gen. XI, 5) וכי מה נאמר בני ח' could we think young asses (built it)?—Y. Dem. I, 21 d bot. Ib. 22 a top; a. fr.
Ab. Zar. 39 a

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. חֲמַר II; cmp. חָמַם) escuro; trnsf. luto.
definicoes_originais: (v. חֲמַר II; cmp. חָמַם) dark; trnsf. mourning.
notas_originais: Targ. Ps. XXXV, 14; XXXVIII, 7 Ms. (ed. חַכִּיר, Lev. הביר; h. text קֹדֵר).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (denominação de חֲמוֹר) condutor de burro, atendente de animais de carga.
definicoes_originais: (denom. of חֲמוֹר) ass-driver, attendant of beasts of burden.
notas_originais: Kidd. IV, 14, a. e., v. גַּמָּל. Kel. XXVI, 5 (6) עור החמיר ועור הח' Maim. (v. comment. ed. Dehr.; Mish. ed. עור הח', Talm. ed. עור החמור) the ass’ leather cover and the ass-driver’s apron; a. fr.—ח' גמל, v. גַּמָּל.— Pl. חַמָּרִים, חַמָּרִין. Dem. IV, 7. Kidd. l. c. a. fr.—Denom.: חִמֵּר to direct a loaded beast’s motions by walking behind it, to load a beast. Sabb. 153 b; Ab. Zar. 15 a המְחַמֵּר אחר וכ' he who drives his beast of burden by walking behind it. Sabb. l. c. והלא מחמר but does he not violate the Sabbath as a driver (by placing his money bag on the ass)?—Pes. 66 b מח' כלאחר יד הוא it is an act of driving in an unusual way (the lamb usually not being used as a beast of burden); a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Y. Taan. Eu, 64b bot. ח' אנא Eu sou um motorista de burro. Ib. פלן ח' יצלי deixe aquele certo motorista de burro orar. [Ib. חמר עבין ההוא גוברא וכ', leia: חמש עבירן וכ', v. Krot.] -Y. Snh. VI, imploro. 23 b הא שאלתא דח' nessa forma seria
notas_originais: Y. Taan. I, 64 b bot. ח' אנא I am an ass-driver. Ib. פלן ח' יצלי let that certain ass-driver pray. [Ib. חמר עבין ההוא גוברא וכ', read: חמש עבירן וכ', v. margin ed. Krot.]—Y. Snh. VI, beg. 23 b הא שאלתא דח' in that form it would be an ass-driver’s question.— Pl. חַמָּרַיָּיא. Y. Taan. IV, 67 c bot.
